findings: Reviewed eight production-UI WebKit captures: light/dark conversation, narrow conversation and Details, Settings, welcome, rename and paused work.

The header owns conversation actions, with explicit rename entry, pending save and failure recovery. Working copy, work state and requests are reachable from the toolbar. Details removes repeated name/lifecycle/model/queue controls and shows measured context use.

Paused work shows only the current run controls, with Continue emphasized. New-run buttons disappear during a run. Narrow Details and rename remain within the window; focused headless journeys cover exact-target actions and focus recovery.

Headless fixtures verify DOM behavior and layout, not native OS-input, IME, system file pickers, VoiceOver or other platforms. The actual desktop rebuilt successfully; archived native receipts remain bound to their recorded sources.
